name: portamp
description: A tiny plugin host that ports legacy front ends. Fifty two input plugins read Angular, AngularJS, Vue, Knockout, Backbone, jQuery, Ember, Marko, Liquid, Twig, XSLT and more, a Windows executable, its resource script, a WinForms, WPF, VB6 or Delphi form, an Electron archive, a photograph of a screen, or a running app with no source; it recognises what it is; it emits React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Lit or a custom element, arranged for Next, Remix, Astro, Nuxt, SvelteKit or Eleventy, with the proofs beside them.

scripts.demo: node src/cli.js run --src example/legacy --shots example/screenshots --out example/out
scripts.demo-site: node src/cli.js run --src example/legacy-site --out example/out-site --site true
scripts.demo-portal: node src/cli.js run --src example/legacy-portal --out example/out-portal --site true
